title: Annotatio V §.VI open: Limits so far Material; Formaliter — the act of limitation in two grades
pass_a_gloss: §. VI. Thus far we have spoken of the Limits of Ecclesiastical Consociation considered Materially. Considered Formally — that is, insofar as they designate the act of this limitation — they become conspicuous in two grades, as it were,
pass_b_english: §. VI. So far we have treated the limits of church Consociation on the material side.
Taken formally — as naming the act of drawing that limit — they show up in roughly two degrees.
source_text:
§. VI.
Hactenus de Limitibus Consociationis Ecclesiasticae, Materialiter consideratis, diximus. Formaliter considerati, seu quatenus limitationis hujus actum designant, duobus quasi gradibus conspicui fiunt,

lemmas.gloss: in two grades as it were
